name: DescribeDBInstanceErrorLog

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances within a region, including instance IDs
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的详情，包括实例ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Valid values:

20
50
100

Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数，取值说明：

20
50
100

默认值：20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，大于0且不超过Integer的最大值，默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC. The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，需要大于查询开始时间，格式为yyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The level of the logs to query. Valid values:

ALL: queries all error logs.
PANIC: queries only abnormal logs.
FATAL: queries only critical logs.
ERROR: queries only error logs
parameters.help_zh:
日志等级，取值如下：

ALL：显示所有级别日志。
PANIC：只显示异常级别日志。
FATAL：只显示严重级别日志。
ERROR：只显示错误级别日志
parameters.name: log_level

parameters.help_en: This parameter is not supported in Alibaba Cloud public cloud
parameters.help_zh: 公共云暂不支持该参数，无需传入
parameters.name: host

parameters.help_en: One or more keywords that are used to query error logs
parameters.name: keywords
